newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort rates Pearson buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort rates Pearson buy.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said on Friday it had reiterated its "buy" recommendation on media stock Pearson Plc and gave an 850p target price for the shares.
"We have been pushing the stock this morning after repeating our buy stance, following the recent underperformance of the shares," a spokesman said.
The shares were trading up 19p at 721-1/2p by 1039 GMT.
"The value story remains intact for us despite the lack of news since Scardino took the reigns," the brokerage said, adding that 700p remains a "floor" price for the stock.
Marjorie Scardino, Pearson's new chief executive has vowed to improve the financial performance and focus of the group.
